purpose: Collect matched empirical calibration evidence without using provider/runtime-dependent efficiency measurements as v0.11 promotion authority.

design.ordering: For each workload, randomly choose which strategy is executed first when practical; record deviations.
design.control_rule: Serial control executes one ready implementation work package at a time in deterministic topological order; verification remains required and obligations may not be reduced.
design.optimized_rule: Optimized plan may execute only dependency- and conflict-safe workstreams concurrently; speculative work stays non-authoritative until gates resolve.

required_shadow_metrics.name: canonical_context_payload_bytes
required_shadow_metrics.denominator: all work packages in each strategy

required_shadow_metrics.name: retry_amplification_work_units
required_shadow_metrics.denominator: exact matched executions whose workload manifest has failure_injection.enabled=true; otherwise metric outcome is NOT_APPLICABLE and excluded by the preregistered applicability predicate

interpretation_rule: v0.11 may report observed empirical deltas only as calibration/shadow evidence. It must not claim general speedup from these trials. A later reproducible runner (roadmap v0.17) may preregister provider/runtime-dependent promotion thresholds.
anti_gaming: missing/skipped execution is unavailable, never zero
failed verification stops time-to-verified completion rather than being counted as fast
parallel strategy must record integration/rework overhead
failure_injection_applicability_rule: failure_injection.enabled is a required boolean workload-manifest field. retry_amplification_work_units applies iff true; false produces NOT_APPLICABLE, never missing/zero.
